findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts two aware datetimes sharing the same ZoneInfo, yielding wall-clock difference rather than elapsed time, so sessions crossing a DST change are over- or under-billed (and may cross a rounding boundary); should convert to UTC first.

judge.reason: Identifies same-tzinfo aware datetime subtraction using wall clock, needing UTC conversion.

findings.label: hit

judge.reason: Finding that tests fail to cover the answer-key DST bug is always valid_other.
